planned_title: Why Will Gliese 710's Comets Arrive After It Has Gone?
spoken: Gliese 710 will send about 10 extra comets a year, falling in close enough for us to see, for three to four million years. straight through the Oort cloud. A star passing through the cloud is like a hand brushing through a bowl of floating marbles. The comets do not arrive while the star is passing. Why? Because they are so far out that falling in takes hundreds of thousands of years.
